messages:
sam: Pen-test report landed. Critical: svc-account overbind -> lateral RBAC; one KMS keyvault had audit exporter disabled; service-to-service auth logs missing. Need owners and a 60m ops window to patch, collect sealed evidence, and schedule retest.

nora: I can take RBAC. Plan: minimal role + canary on svc-deploy-canary. Will snapshot IAM before change and produce a terraform plan showing diffs.

diego: I'll do KMS + audit exports. We have keys in GCP and Azure Key Vault. Will pull Cloud Audit + Azure Diagnostic slices for 30d and capture key metadata. No rotations until after evidence capture.

ops-oncall: Standby for window. If control-plane impact, page SRE. Rollback plan: reapply pre-iam JSON and restore terraform state from rollback branch.

sam: Proposed window: Mon 2024-10-14 18:00 UTC, duration 60m. Sequence: pre-snapshots -> apply RBAC canary -> monitor 20m -> collect KMS logs -> seal + sign -> upload -> presigned links to vendor.

nora: Canary steps: 1) export pre-iam: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json` 2) apply custom role `infra.limited` via terraform 3) attach to svc-deploy-canary 4) monitor auth failures and latency for 20m 5) roll or rollback.

diego: KMS export examples: GCP `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=30d --format=json > kms-gcp-30d.ndjson`; Azure `az monitor activity-log list --start-time 2024-09-14 --end-time 2024-10-14 --query "[?contains(operationName.value,'Microsoft.KeyVault') ]" > kv-az-30d.json`. Also `gcloud kms keys describe` and `az keyvault key show`.

diego: Packaging: tar -> sha256 -> cosign sign -> detached GPG sign. Example: `tar -czf kms-30d.tgz *.ndjson && sha256sum kms-30d.tgz > kms-30d.tgz.sha256 && cosign sign --key cosign.key kms-30d.tgz && gpg --detach-sign kms-30d.tgz`. Include capture commands in manifest.

ops-oncall: I'll add a short-lived log-based metric for `PERMISSION_DENIED` spikes and SetIamPolicy events. If denied rate > baseline by 5% for 10m -> auto rollback and page.

sam: Nora, please ensure terraform state snapshot is pushed to `rollback-state` branch and attach the `tf plan -out` to the PR.

nora: Will do. PR ETA: today EOD with plan and rollback instructions.

diego: I'll upload artifacts to `gs://pt-evidence-4567` with versioning and retention lock. Will provide presigned GETs valid 7d and include operator session IDs (tlog) in the manifest.

evidence-bot: Vendor: please provide PGP fingerprint and cosign public key so we can sign and vendor can verify.

vendor-bot: CypherAudit awaiting keys. Also request operator audit chain and timestamps.

sam: Final owners checklist: nora (RBAC PR + pre/post snapshots), diego (KMS exports + keymeta + sealed upload), ops-oncall (alerts + rollback), sam (vendor coordination). React with :thumbsup: to accept.

nora: :thumbsup:

diego: :thumbsup: starting key list now

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: pager ready

sam: I'll lock the calendar and post vendor retest slot once artifacts are uploaded. Keep updates here for final manifest link and signatures.
